item.title: GA Senate Candidate Says He Didn’t Vote For Nearly Two Decades
item.description: Derek Dooley, a former football coach, says he did not vote for nearly two decades. He thinks that makes him a good candidate to replace Georgia’s Jon Ossoff in the U.S. Senate. I guess Herschel Walker was unavailable. Dooley did not vote for Donald Trump in either 2016 or 2020 but supposedly voted for him in 2024. That was after returning to the voting booth in 2022, when he voted to re-elect Georgia’s current governor, Republican Brian Kemp, AP reported. Kemp is also a long-time family friend.
